title: lerdahl
description: `lerdahl` provides melodic analysis abstractions based on Fred Lerdahl’s TPS book, outputting values including pitch class, basic space, melodic tension, attraction, closure, pitch-class distance, and perceptual fusion. It accepts MIDI-range floats (0–127), defaults to C3 (60) in Ionian/Major, and its optional first argument sets the initial pitch-class offset.
